title.note: Game title, glossary keep; Bangladeshi players search and talk about Roblox games by their English names.

hud.cast.note: Angling idiom 'ছিপ ফেলা' (cast the rod), not a spell or throw in general. 8 of 8 by lint: check the round button in Studio; 'ফেলো' alone (4) is the fallback.

hud.reel.note: 'Pull!' -- what a Bengali angler does when a fish bites. Same verb as the pass অটো টান. Not 'রিল', which reads as Facebook/Instagram Reels in Bangladesh.

hud.bait_left.note: টোপ = fishing bait. Bengali nouns don't change after a number, so this reads right for 0, 1 and 12 (guide pattern '{count} কয়েন').

catch.success.note: Bengali adjectives are uninflected and go before the noun, so '{rarity} {fish}' works for every tier and fish (e.g. 'তুমি দুর্লভ সোনালি কার্প ধরেছ!'); no article problem. 'ধরেছ' (have caught) avoids the 'if' reading of 'ধরলে'.

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit with the generic word for fish, as context allows; 'ছুটে গেল' = slipped free, the angler's phrase. Spoken টা classifier for a toast.

catch.new_record.note: কেজি is how Bangladesh writes kg in everyday text. The game's '12.4' (Latin digits, decimal point) reads fine here.

fish.golden_carp.note: কার্প is the familiar Bangladeshi fish word (গ্রাস কার্প, সিলভার কার্প are market fish); সোনালি = golden. Base form, works inserted into catch.success.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Translated per glossary: লণ্ঠন (lantern) keeps the glowing-lantern idea; বাইম is the eel Bangladeshi kids know from the market (বান মাছ is the zoological true eel, a possible alternative). Spelling লণ্ঠন vs লন্ঠন: both are seen; check with a native reviewer.

rarity.mythic.note: Transliterated to match the guide's লেজেন্ডারি for Legendary; Mobile Legends (big in Bangladesh) ranks Mythic above Legend, so gamers read it as the higher tier. 'পৌরাণিক' is bookish. Ordering by kids unverified.

shop.rods.note: ছিপ = fishing rod. Not 'রড', which in Bangladesh means steel construction rod; not 'বড়শি' (hook). No plural needed for a tab label.

shop.equip.note: 'Take it in hand' -- natural for a rod and pairs with the label হাতে আছে. 'ব্যবহার করো' (use) is 10 of 10 if a reviewer prefers it; 'ইকুইপ করো' is gamer English.

shop.equipped.note: State label 'in hand (now)', pairs with the button হাতে নাও. No gender agreement in Bengali. Avoided 'ব্যবহৃত', which means second-hand.

pass.auto_reel.note: 'Auto Pull': অটো is a common loan, টান is the noun of টানো (hud.reel), so the same verb as glossary asks. Not 'অটো রিল' (Reels). Store name in Creator Hub should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: লাকি টোপ তোমার দুর্লভ মাছ ধরার সম্ভাবনা দ্বিগুণ করে!
pass.lucky_bait.note: লাকি follows the guide's 'লাকি পোশন' and the term লাক (luck); টোপ = Bait. 'ধরার সম্ভাবনা' = chance of catching. Tags kept around the pass name.

sell.all.note: 12 of 12 by lint; check in Studio. 'সব বেচো' (7) is a shorter, more colloquial fallback.

sell.done.note: Restructured: 'sold {count} fish and got {coins} coins'. টি classifier never changes with the number and currency takes none, so 1 reads right. 'পেয়েছ' rather than 'পেলে' (could read as 'if you get').

ascend.button.note: Transliterated like the guide's রিবার্থ for Rebirth: the guide bans religious words for prestige, and native 'আরোহণ' means climbing, 'উত্তরণ' is bookish. Kids learn its meaning from ascend.confirm. Player familiarity unverified.

ascend.confirm.text: এখনই অ্যাসেন্ড করবে? আবার প্রথম থেকে শুরু করতে হবে, কিন্তু দুর্লভ মাছ {bonus}% বেশি ধরা পড়বে।
ascend.confirm.note: 'start over' = 'you'll have to start again from the beginning'; '{bonus}% more often' rendered as rare fish 'get caught {bonus}% more', the natural Bengali way to say it. Percent attached to the number.

weather.storm.text: ঝড় আসছে! দুর্লভ মাছ টোপ খাচ্ছে।
weather.storm.note: 'টোপ খাচ্ছে' = taking the bait, the fishing sense of 'biting' (not biting people).

quest.title.note: Guide vocabulary: quest = মিশন, one term per game. Bengali titles need no plural.

quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay translated per glossary: চাঁদনি = moonlit, উপসাগর = bay (kids know it from বঙ্গোপসাগর, Bay of Bengal). '-এ' locative attaches to the Bengali word. 'চাঁদনি খাঁড়ি' (cove) fits a lake better if a native reviewer prefers. {n}টি works for 1.

friends.boost.text: বন্ধুদের সাথে মাছ ধরলে +{percent}% লাক পাবে
friends.boost.note: Statement as a condition: 'if you fish with friends you get +{percent}% luck'. লাক is the everyday Bangladeshi loan, matching লাকি টোপ; 'ভাগ্য' is the native option if the reviewer prefers.

trade.sent.note: The -কে suffix never changes with the name, so it is safe after {player}; hyphenated per the guide. ট্রেড per guide.

trade.accept.note: 'agreed to your trade' -- spoken toast wording; ordinary third person, no gender. 'তোমার ট্রেডের অনুরোধ গ্রহণ করেছে' (30) is the literal alternative.

codes.redeemed.text: কোড রিডিম হয়েছে! পুরস্কার উপভোগ করো।
codes.redeemed.note: রিডিম is the word Bangladeshi kids know from Free Fire redeem codes (familiarity unverified); 'কোড কাজ করেছে!' (the code worked) is the plain-native fallback.

afk.kicked.text: তুমি অনেকক্ষণ ধরে কিছু করোনি, তাই তোমার মাছ ধরা বন্ধ হয়ে গেছে।
afk.kicked.note: 'idle' = 'did nothing for a long while'; avoided 'অলস' (lazy), which judges. No mention of being kicked, as the source has none.

settings.back.note: Standard Back wording (Bengali Android uses ফিরে যান; তুমি form here). 8 of 8 by lint; check in Studio.

settings.sfx.note: Loanword, as the guide renders Music as মিউজিক; 'শব্দ প্রভাব' would be a calque.

event.ends.note: For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h' with English unit letters, which Bengali readers won't parse well. Per the guide, format it as '2 দিন 4 ঘণ্টা' for bn-bd, or use a bare 02:15:30 timer. 13 of 14.

daily.streak.text: টানা {day} দিনের স্ট্রিক! আরও পুরস্কার পেতে কাল আবার এসো।
daily.streak.note: স্ট্রিক (from Snapchat/Duolingo) is glossed by টানা 'in a row' for kids who don't know it; no plural, so day 1 reads right. 'for more' = more rewards. Familiarity of স্ট্রিক unverified.

tip.night.text: টিপস: কিছু মাছ শুধু রাতেই টোপ খায়।
tip.night.note: টিপস is the common Bangladeshi label for a tip, even singular. 'টোপ খায়' = take the bait (fishing sense of 'bite').

group.join.text: আমাদের গ্রুপে যোগ দিয়ে ফ্রিতে 50টি টোপ নাও!
group.join.note: 'the group' made 'আমাদের গ্রুপ' (our group), as the guide's group reward line does, so it reads as the studio's group. 'ফ্রিতে' = for free, colloquial. 50 kept.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish', since the board ranks by weight; 'সবচেয়ে বড়' would suggest size.
